Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and Implemented highly scalable asynchronous, multithreaded and most cost effective image processing data pipeline ​using Python​, Tornado​, PostgreSQL,​ Docker-Machine​, Docker

● Designed and Implemented custom broker for cloud Infrastructure to deploy containerized microservices​ at scale to handle multi terabytes​ of data processing efficiently every second.

● Designed and Developed containerized microservices and tools to automate image processing tasks​ efficiently and integrate​ it with data processing pipeline.

● Designed and Implemented highly scalable, multithreaded Satellite Data Benchmarking API​s and visualization layer to display field performance for calibrated raster data.

● Designed and Developed Pipeline Monitoring System called “Watchdog” to actively monitor and notify about issues across whole infrastructure using Python, Tornado, Redis​ and wrote a slack-bot​ for that.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and Implemented high performance scalable features & APIs on server side using PHP, MySQL, Python, MongoDB and Amazon AWS services like EC2, S3 etc.

* Responsible for developing/designing high speed, scalable message queue for passing various documents through different stages of data pipeline using Kafka and Tornado.

* Built REST APIs for our service side clients and services.

* Involved in code reviews using Github, deployments, collaborating with other engineers, identifying and fixing production issues.

* Responsible for deployment and maintenance of production Linux servers.

* Integrated multiple cloud accounting systems by developing APIs and client libraries using Python, Tornado for seamless user experience. Open Source Contribution to : https://github.com/freakboy3742/pyxero

* Integrated credit card based subscription services developed using JavaScript, Python;

* Integrated payment gateway APIs for online Bank to Bank (ACH) payment over SFTP channel as well as online check payment system and user risk profiling using Python, Tornado.

projects.title: Captain Craigs - Craigslist Fraud Detection System
projects.description: Developed a system for detecting fraudulent posts on craigslist using Python, Flask and Bootstrap for UI. System takes in any important information from a particular post such as contact information/email and crawls posts from craigslist websites from surrounding area and compares that particular post with crawled posts for matching patterns.

projects.title: SmartDroid - Autonomous System for Android Devices
projects.description:
Developed a Smart Intelligent Location-Aware Android Application in which user can make rules and profiles according to the daily situations for e.g. Switch phone to silent mode when in the office. or get a pop-up notification when in particular area. for example "buy milk when in downtown". 
Used JAVA, Android SDK and SHARED PREFERENCES to store data and share across different processes.
